convert-pdf-to-docx-layout.description: Demonstrates converting a PDF file to a DOCX document using Aspose.Pdf's standard textbox recognition mode to preserve the original layout.

convert-pdf-to-docx-with-footnotes.title: Convert PDF to DOCX with Footnotes Preservation
convert-pdf-to-docx-with-footnotes.description: Demonstrates converting a PDF file to DOCX using Aspose.Pdf while preserving footnotes by enabling the EnhancedFlow recognition mode.

convert-pdf-to-docx-extract-images.title: Convert PDF to DOCX and Extract Embedded Images
convert-pdf-to-docx-extract-images.description: Demonstrates how to convert a PDF file to DOCX format using Aspose.Pdf and then iterate through each page to extract all embedded images into a specified folder.

convert-pdf-to-docx-with-stats.title: Convert PDF to DOCX with Conversion Statistics
convert-pdf-to-docx-with-stats.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf to convert a PDF file to DOCX format while capturing conversion metrics such as file sizes, page count, and elapsed time, and outputs the results as JSON.

convert-pdf-to-docx-and-zip.title: Convert PDF to DOCX and Zip the Result
convert-pdf-to-docx-and-zip.description: Shows how to use Aspose.Pdf to convert a PDF file to DOCX format and then compress the generated DOCX into a ZIP archive for storage.

convert-pdf-to-docx-and-pdfa.title: Convert PDF to DOCX and then to PDF/A
convert-pdf-to-docx-and-pdfa.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, converting it to a DOCX file, and then creating a PDF/A‑1B compliant document from the generated DOCX.

convert-pdf-to-docx-with-hyphenation.title: Convert PDF to DOCX with Hyphenation and Flow Settings
convert-pdf-to-docx-with-hyphenation.description: Demonstrates converting a PDF file to DOCX using Aspose.Pdf while applying flow‑based recognition and language‑aware hyphenation settings.

convert-pdf-to-docx-add-table-of-figures.description: Demonstrates converting a PDF file to DOCX using Aspose.Pdf while extracting images, generating captions, and inserting a table of figures into the document.

convert-pdf-to-docx-with-embedded-fonts.title: Convert PDF to DOCX with Embedded Fonts
convert-pdf-to-docx-with-embedded-fonts.description: Demonstrates converting a PDF file to a DOCX document using Aspose.Pdf while embedding fonts to preserve layout and appearance.

convert-pdf-to-pptx.title: Convert PDF to Editable PPTX
convert-pdf-to-pptx.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf and save it as an editable PowerPoint presentation using the default PPTX save options.

convert-pdf-to-pptx-and-compress.title: Convert PDF to PPTX and Compress the Resulting File
convert-pdf-to-pptx-and-compress.description: Demonstrates converting a PDF document to PPTX using Aspose.Pdf and then recompressing the PPTX (a ZIP archive) with optimal compression to reduce file size.

convert-pdf-to-pptx__v2.title: Convert PDF to PPTX with Aspose.Pdf
convert-pdf-to-pptx__v2.description: Shows how to convert a PDF document to a PPTX presentation using Aspose.Pdf and mentions the optional step of password‑protecting the PPTX with Aspose.Slides.

convert-pdf-to-pptx-and-pdfa.title: Convert PDF to PPTX and then to PDF/A

convert-pdf-to-pptx-with-annotation-note.title: Convert PDF to PPTX and Add Speaker Notes from Annotations
convert-pdf-to-pptx-with-annotation-note.description: Demonstrates converting a PDF document to a PPTX file using Aspose.Pdf and extracting annotation contents to use as speaker notes for each slide.

convert-pdf-to-pptx-add-custom-propertie.title: Convert PDF to PPTX and Add Custom Document Properties
convert-pdf-to-pptx-add-custom-propertie.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, set standard and custom document properties, and save the document as a PPTX file.

convert-pdf-to-pptx__v3.title: Convert PDF to PPTX Presentation
convert-pdf-to-pptx__v3.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF file with Aspose.Pdf and save it directly as a PPTX presentation using the Save method and SaveFormat.Pptx.

convert-pdf-to-pptx__v4.title: Convert PDF to PPTX using Aspose.Pdf
convert-pdf-to-pptx__v4.description: Shows how to convert a PDF document to a PowerPoint PPTX file by using Aspose.Pdf's Document class and its Save method with the Pptx format.

convert-pdf-to-pptx-extract-images.description: Shows how to convert a PDF document to a PPTX presentation with Aspose.Pdf and then extract the images embedded in the generated slides by reading the PPTX ZIP structure.

pdf-to-pptx-export-slide-titles-csv.title: Convert PDF to PPTX and Export Slide Titles to CSV

convert-pdf-to-pptx-with-logo.description: Shows how to load a PDF, overlay a logo image on every page, and then save the modified document as a PPTX presentation using Aspose.Pdf.

convert-pdf-to-pptx__v5.description: Shows how to convert a PDF document to a PPTX presentation using Aspose.Pdf's Document.Save method.

convert-pdf-to-html-png-background.title: Convert PDF to HTML with PNG Page Backgrounds
convert-pdf-to-html-png-background.description: Shows how to convert a PDF document to HTML using Aspose.Pdf while rendering each page's background images as a single embedded PNG.

convert-pdf-pages-to-separate-html-files.title: Convert PDF Pages to Separate HTML Files
convert-pdf-pages-to-separate-html-files.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf to convert each page of a PDF into its own HTML file by enabling the SplitIntoPages option.

pdf-to-html-with-toc.title: Convert PDF to HTML with Automatic Table of Contents
pdf-to-html-with-toc.description: Demonstrates converting a PDF file to a single HTML document using Aspose.Pdf and then generating a navigable table of contents by adding IDs to heading tags.

pdf-to-html-per-page-image-folders.title: Convert PDF to HTML with Per‑Page Image Subfolders
pdf-to-html-per-page-image-folders.description: Demonstrates converting a PDF to HTML using Aspose.Pdf, splitting the output into separate pages and saving each page's images into its own subfolder via a custom resource‑saving strategy.

convert-pdf-to-html-compressed-svg.title: Convert PDF to HTML with Compressed SVG Images
convert-pdf-to-html-compressed-svg.description: Demonstrates converting a PDF document to HTML using Aspose.Pdf while enabling the CompressSvgGraphicsIfAny option to generate compressed SVG assets.

convert-pdf-to-html-png-background__v2.title: Convert PDF to HTML with PNG Page Backgrounds
convert-pdf-to-html-png-background__v2.description: Shows how to convert a PDF to HTML using Aspose.Pdf and configure HtmlSaveOptions to render each page background as an embedded PNG image.

convert-pdf-to-html-zip.description: Shows how to use Aspose.Pdf to convert a PDF into separate HTML pages with assets and then package the generated files into a ZIP archive.

convert-pdf-to-html-and-minify.title: Convert PDF to Single-File HTML and Minify Output
convert-pdf-to-html-and-minify.description: Demonstrates converting a PDF to a single HTML file using Aspose.Pdf and then minifying the generated HTML by stripping comments and collapsing whitespace.

convert-pdf-to-html-with-custom-css.title: Convert PDF to HTML with Custom CSS

convert-pdf-to-html-sitemap.description: Shows how to convert a PDF document to a single HTML file with Aspose.Pdf and then create a sitemap.xml that lists the generated HTML page for SEO purposes.

convert-pdf-to-html-pages-with-index.title: Convert PDF to Separate HTML Pages with Index

convert-pdf-to-multi-page-tiff.description: Demonstrates how to convert all pages of a PDF into a single multi-page TIFF image using Aspose.Pdf's TiffDevice with custom resolution and settings.

convert-pdf-to-svg.title: Convert PDF to SVG using Aspose.Pdf
convert-pdf-to-svg.description: Shows how to load a PDF document and save each page as SVG images using the default SvgSaveOptions.

convert-pdf-to-multi-page-tiff__v2.title: Convert PDF to Multi‑Page TIFF
convert-pdf-to-multi-page-tiff__v2.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf and use TiffDevice to convert all pages into a single multi‑page TIFF file using default settings.

extract-pdf-page-region-to-png.title: Extract PDF Page Region to PNG
extract-pdf-page-region-to-png.description: Shows how to define a rectangular region on a PDF page using the CropBox and render that area to a PNG image with Aspose.Pdf.

batch-convert-pdfs-to-jpeg-custom-naming.description: Demonstrates how to convert all PDF files in a folder to JPEG images page‑by‑page using Aspose.Pdf, applying a custom file‑naming pattern for each output image.

add-external-xml-attachment-to-pdfa.title: Add External XML Attachment to PDF/A‑1b Document

convert-ofd-to-pdf.title: Convert OFD to PDF with Aspose.Pdf
convert-ofd-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates loading an OFD file using OfdLoadOptions and saving it as a PDF with default settings.

convert-pdf-to-epub.title: Convert PDF to EPUB with Aspose.Pdf
convert-pdf-to-epub.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF file and saving it as an EPUB using Aspose.Pdf with the default conversion settings.

convert-pdf-to-latex-with-custom-macros.title: Convert PDF to LaTeX with Custom Macro Definitions

convert-pdf-to-xps-custom-page-size.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, applying a custom page size and landscape orientation to each page, and saving the result as an XPS document using Aspose.Pdf.

convert-pdf-to-markdown-default-options.title: Convert PDF to Markdown with Default Options
convert-pdf-to-markdown-default-options.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF file with Aspose.Pdf and saving it as a Markdown document using the default MarkdownSaveOptions.

pdf-to-markdown-with-heading-mapping.description: Demonstrates how to convert a PDF file to Markdown using Aspose.Pdf while configuring heading recognition and custom heading levels.

convert-pdf-to-mobixml-with-metadata.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, setting both standard (author) and custom (publisher) metadata, and saving the document as a MobiXml file.

convert-pdf-to-svg-custom-output.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, configure SvgSaveOptions, and save each page as SVG files into a specified output directory.
